title: Power Plant — Fan Cowl Latch Replacement with Positive Unlatched Indication
abstract: Mandatory replacement of the fan cowl latches by an assembly whose keeper drives a red flag out of the cowl line when the latch is not fully engaged, following a cowl loss during a take-off roll.

sections.planning_reason: Three departures with a fan cowl unlatched were reported across the fleet in two years, one of which ended with the cowl departing the aircraft during the take-off roll and damaging the flap. In every case the walk-around had been done and the latch had been left hanging in a position that is hard to see from ground level with the engine in its installed attitude. No fault was found with the latch mechanism itself; a correctly latched cowl and an unlatched one look almost identical from the only place a crew member ever stands.
sections.description: The bulletin replaces both latch assemblies on each fan cowl with a unit whose keeper carries a red painted flag that is mechanically driven out of the cowl line when the latch is not fully engaged, and which cannot be stowed unless the hook is over centre.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the fan cowl and support it. Do the removal task AMM-C-71-10-12-000-020-A for each latch assembly. Remove the clamp D7110124986440 and the seal D7110121607820 at the latch aperture. Enlarge the keeper aperture in the cowl to the template supplied with the kit and re-protect the machined edge. Install the shroud kit AR674643-02 and the nozzle assembly CAD746437-78 with the flag cut-out. Install the new latch assembly and set the over-centre position with the gauge. Install the seal and the shorter clamp and reposition the nozzle sub-assembly D7110129326915. Renew the washers EN17059-86 at each latch. Do the installation task AMM-C-71-10-12-400-020-A and check the flag deployment at the unlatched, partly latched and latched positions. Apply the placard prohibiting a mixed installation on one cowl. Close the cowl and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to all CIRRANE-11 and CIRRANE-13 aircraft delivered with the original latch. Aircraft from MSN C00342 onward are already at the standard. A mixed installation of old and new latches on one cowl is prohibited and is placarded.
sections.material_note: Kit K7110-2002-01 is supplied per engine and contains two latch assemblies, the shroud, the nozzle assembly, the seals, the clamps and the aperture template. Lead time is twelve weeks. Removed latches are returned for teardown for the first fifty embodiments.

type_data.compliance_time: Within thirty months after the effective date of the airworthiness directive.
